t: Fortress 5Ltr Cedar Decking Oil is a high-performance, water-based solution formulated to protect and rejuvenate outdoor timber decking. This quick-drying oil provides robust water resistance and breathability, essential for safeguarding wood against the elements. Its rich cedar hue enhances the natural beauty of decking boards, creating an appealing finish for garden patios and exterior wooden structures. With a convenient touch-dry time of just one hour and recoatability within the same period, projects can be completed efficiently. The oil applies easily with a brush or roller, offering excellent coverage of up to 12m² per litre, making it a practical choice for timber deck maintenance.
